constraints: posixPath must be an absolute disk path beginning with "/"; network paths (e.g. ftp://...) are not supported.

The '*' literal-symbol parameter tells the command that posixPath is percent-encoded (special characters escaped); if posixPath is actually encoded but '*' is omitted, the returned system path is invalid. Without '*', the output path is not encoded either.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Converts an absolute POSIX-syntax pathname to the equivalent pathname in the current platform's system syntax.
